title: oenothera pilosella subsp. sessilis
intro: Oenothera pilosella subsp. sessilis, commonly known as the sessile evening primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the willowherb family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera pilosella subsp. sessilis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research on this plant is limited, but its bioactive constituents may contribute to its potential health benefits.
